rule: Object/process separation improves traceability and professional honesty; it is not itself a certification claim.

comparisons.area: test process separation and evidence flow
observed_alignment: work execution is separated from verification
independent verification is separated from worker results
assessment report is the receipt source
falsification tests cover prohibited state transitions
separate identifiers for flag events, tickets, work results, verifications, assessments and receipts

comparisons.area: maintainability, reliability and accountability-related product qualities
observed_alignment: explicit object boundaries reduce accidental state coupling
receipt issuance is fail-closed behind verification

comparisons.area: human-centred separation of user workflows from operational plumbing
observed_alignment: operational flag/ticket/verification state remains diagnostic/coordination data rather than customer-facing task success

comparisons.reference: ACM Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct
observed_alignment: actor work cannot self-issue an independent receipt
ticket closure cannot be represented as verified remediation
work-result and ticket state are not promoted into verified clearance state
